groups.name: Start here
groups.blurb: Small Beginner puzzles that need only the easiest rules.

groups.name: Default
groups.blurb: The plain board sizes: a thousand puzzles each, easiest first.

groups.name: Bonus
groups.blurb: Variations on the usual puzzle: the same rules, a different feel.

Arrows.blurb: What the arrows point at, and what they say

Boxes.blurb: Few boxes, or a board packed with them

groups.name: Diagonal
groups.blurb: Arrows that point along diagonals and count the boxes on them.

groups.name: Regional
groups.blurb: No arrows: a number says how many boxes its region holds. An experiment.

books.blurb: The smallest board: quick puzzles, a few easier ones among them.

books.name: Bonus: the long way round
books.label: The long way round
books.blurb: Arrows point away from the nearest edge: long lines of sight.

books.name: Bonus: one direction
books.label: One direction
books.blurb: Every arrow in a puzzle points the same way.

books.name: Bonus: all zeros
books.label: All zeros
books.blurb: Every arrow says 0: its line holds no boxes, so the boxes hide elsewhere.

books.name: Bonus: big numbers
books.label: Big numbers
books.blurb: Large numbers on the arrows; some puzzles go further and every arrow says 2 or more.

books.name: Bonus: few boxes
books.label: Few boxes
books.blurb: Under a third of the non-loop cells are boxes: lots of arrows, a long loop.

books.name: Bonus: packed with boxes
books.label: Packed with boxes
books.blurb: Over half the non-loop cells are boxes, with few arrows to say where.

books.name: Bonus: skinny
books.label: Skinny
books.blurb: Narrow boards, up to 36 cells long: a ribbon to follow.

books.name: Bonus: voids
books.label: Voids
books.blurb: Crossed-out blocks are void: nothing goes there. The loop avoids them and arrows count straight through them.

books.name: Diagonal: all diagonal
books.label: All diagonal
books.blurb: Every arrow points along a diagonal, so a diagonal arrow counts the boxes on its diagonal to the edge. Beginner to Hard.

books.name: Diagonal: half diagonal
books.label: Half diagonal
books.blurb: Half the arrows are diagonal, the rest point up, down, left or right.

books.name: Diagonal: a quarter diagonal
books.label: A quarter diagonal
books.blurb: Mostly ordinary arrows, with a quarter of them diagonal.

books.name: Experiment: regional corpus
books.label: Regional corpus (experiment)
books.blurb: No arrows: thick lines cut the board into regions and a number says how many boxes its region holds. A spread of styles for finding the techniques.
